//: Marketplace catalog. Copy to plugin-registry.json (gitignored) or point GROKBOT2_PLUGIN_REGISTRY at a file or URL. Credentials are ${PLACEHOLDERS} resolved at spawn from the backend environment or .data/secrets/<user>.json — never write a real token here, this file is meant to be shared. Each placeholder becomes a field in the client's setup form; `credentials` only supplies its label and hint. `logoUrl` must be https — the client fetches it in the main process and rejects any other scheme.

plugins.name: memory
plugins.description: Knowledge graph the agent writes to and recalls from across sessions. No credentials.

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: Repos, issues, pull requests and code search.

GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN.title: Personal access token
GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: GitHub → Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens. Give it the repo scope.

plugins.name: lark
plugins.description: Messages, docs, sheets, calendar and Base through the Lark OpenAPI.

LARK_APP_ID.title: App ID
LARK_APP_ID.description: open.larksuite.com → your app → Credentials & Basic Info.

LARK_APP_SECRET.title: App Secret
LARK_APP_SECRET.description: Same page as the App ID.

plugins.name: gmail
plugins.description: Read, search, draft and send mail. Sign in once first: npx @gongrzhe/server-gmail-autoauth-mcp auth

GMAIL_OAUTH_PATH.title: OAuth client file
GMAIL_OAUTH_PATH.description: Optional. Path to gcp-oauth.keys.json if it is not in the default place.

GMAIL_CREDENTIALS_PATH.title: Saved credentials file
GMAIL_CREDENTIALS_PATH.description: Optional. Where the one-time sign-in stores its token.

plugins.name: facebook
plugins.description: Post to a Page, read comments and insights. Community package, not audited by us.

FACEBOOK_ACCESS_TOKEN.title: Page access token
FACEBOOK_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Graph API Explorer → your Page → generate a long-lived token.

plugins.name: notion
plugins.description: Search, read and write pages and databases. Share the pages your integration may touch with it.

NOTION_TOKEN.title: Integration token
NOTION_TOKEN.description: notion.so/my-integrations → create one, then share the pages it may read with it.

plugins.name: playwright
plugins.description: Drive a real browser: open pages, click, fill forms, read the accessibility tree. No credentials.

plugins.name: n8n
plugins.description: Build and run n8n workflows. Serves node documentation even with no instance configured.

N8N_API_URL.title: n8n URL
N8N_API_URL.description: e.g. http://localhost:5678 — leave empty to browse node docs only.

N8N_API_KEY.title: API key
N8N_API_KEY.description: n8n → Settings → API. Only needed to run workflows.

plugins.name: filesystem
plugins.description: Read and write files under one folder you choose.

GROKBOT2_FS_ROOT.title: Folder the agent may use
GROKBOT2_FS_ROOT.description: One absolute path. The agent can read and write anything under it, and nothing outside.

plugins.name: context7

plugins.name: sequential-thinking

plugins.name: zernio

ZERNIO_API_KEY.title: Zernio API key
ZERNIO_API_KEY.description: From your Zernio dashboard. Leave the browser sign-in to Zernio itself if you prefer OAuth.
